ITEM 1 | Bright red strawberry pieces, halved and sliced, glossy with juicy surfaces, some with white tips, sitting at upper left of plate, roughly 4 whole/halved berries plus slices covering about 8% of plate | 60
ITEM 2 | Cubes of watermelon-like fruit, bright pink-red flesh with slightly translucent edges, cut into roughly 2 cm chunks, moist surface, lying in a cluster at upper left, about 6% of plate | 55
ITEM 3 | Small dark blueberries, deep blue-black with slight sheen, scattered in small groups near the strawberries, about 1 cm each, roughly 5 berries | 15
ITEM 4 | Blackberries, dark purple-black drupelets with a bumpy textured surface, clustered in two small groups at upper right and right edge, about 2 cm across each | 25
ITEM 5 | Mound of finely textured grey-black grain or seed mixture, tiny granular particles with a matte surface, slightly dry, piled in a rounded heap about 7 cm across at right of plate | 110
ITEM 6 | Crumbly white soft cubes, irregular chunks about 1 cm, matte and slightly moist, pale ivory color, forming a loose heap about 9 cm across at lower center | 100
ITEM 7 | Golden-brown roasted potato-like cubes, about 2 cm pieces, crisp browned edges with lightly charred spots, slightly glossy from oil, arranged in a cluster at lower right, about 10% of plate | 90
